request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.

Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Image 1 shows Sofia (left) and Luis (right). Keep both faces, skin and builds exactly, and keep their clothes: Sofia in her bright blue blazer over a white blouse, Luis in his navy T-shirt. Sofia's dark curly hair is tied LOW at the back of her neck, flat on top, with NO bun and no hair standing up on top of her head. Create a new photograph of THREE people standing side by side with a small gap between them against a plain light-grey wall, all smiling at the camera, their whole bodies visible from head to shoes, all in flat shoes on the same floor: on the LEFT Sofia, who is clearly the SHORTEST, the top of her head only as high as the middle woman's chin; in the MIDDLE a woman of medium height with long dark wavy hair and light-olive skin in a sage-green overshirt over a white top (Ana), the top of her head only as high as Luis's chin; on the RIGHT Luis, who is very tall and clearly the TALLEST. The three heights make clear steps like stairs from left to right. Only these three people are in the photo.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
